lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hey Patricia, Jean here. How's your Wednesday going?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hi, sorry, I'm in the car but I can talk.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Here's what I had in mind for today, but tell me if you'd rather focus on something else.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That works.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How have you been feeling since we last talked?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I've had more energy, I noticed that.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: That's great to hear.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So did you manage to keep it to 2 drinks on the weekend?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: It went really well, I actually did it 2 times.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Good for you for planning ahead.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you think 5 days is realistic?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, I think so. It was a long weekend with family, you know how it is.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You kept going even on a hard week. That says a lot about you.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll set an alarm on my phone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You really shouldn't be drinking at all after cancer.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What would your family say about these changes?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Got it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I feel so much better on Sunday when I don't overdo it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is it mostly beer?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Got it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: No, not really. I just didn't feel like it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You just weren't feeling it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I guess.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: If you don't do this, your health is going to suffer.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Maybe after the summer.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You have to make this a priority.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, but you don't know my schedule.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What do you think the next step should be?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'm not sure.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You really shouldn't be drinking at all after cancer.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Easy for you to say.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What feels doable for next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: So, let's say I keep it to 2 drinks on the weekend.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: If the parties gets in the way again, what's your backup plan?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll ask my son to come with me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I'll text you midweek to see how it's going, and we'll talk again in two weeks.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Can we do a little later? I have an appointment.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Talk soon!

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Thanks, bye bye.
